phase_meta.summary: Add a generic pre-validation presentation layer downstream of finalized Evidence Map rows, without changing Quick Check router semantics or claiming formal VVB authority.
current_focus: Phase 0 terminology and compatibility contract is complete
Phase 1 status consumer audit is complete
Phase 2 Evidence Map dependency contract is next
Keep the Evidence Map upstream and canonical
Keep the Pre-Validation Readiness Report and UI downstream

phase_0_report_terminology_contract.title: Phase 0: Report Terminology Contract
phase_0_report_terminology_contract.summary: Define additive pre-validation language, draft finding terminology, prohibited formal-authority claims, and preservation of existing statuses without mappings.

phase_1_status_consumer_audit.title: Phase 1: Status Consumer Audit
phase_1_status_consumer_audit.summary: Audit every producer, storage boundary, transformation, comparison, filter, display, fixture, analytics, and test consumer of FOUND, UNCLEAR, MISSING, answered, unclear, and no_evidence without changing runtime semantics.

phase_2_evidence_map_dependency_contract.title: Phase 2: Evidence Map Dependency Contract
phase_2_evidence_map_dependency_contract.summary: Require finalized Evidence Map rows, accepted and rejected evidence retention, client actions, assessment reasons, and full provenance before presentation.

phase_3_conformance_conclusion_contract.title: Phase 3: Conformance Conclusion Contract
phase_3_conformance_conclusion_contract.summary: Define when finalized Evidence Map support may produce CONFORMS, ACTION_REQUIRED, NOT_APPLICABLE, or NOT_ASSESSED.

phase_4_draft_action_finding_contract.title: Phase 4: Draft Action/Finding Contract
phase_4_draft_action_finding_contract.summary: Define draftFindingType and draftFindingRecord mappings for unclear, missing, and weak non-blocking Evidence Map rows.

phase_5_applicability_contract.title: Phase 5: Applicability Contract
phase_5_applicability_contract.summary: Ensure NOT_APPLICABLE is derived only from an explicit applicability decision, not from missing or unclear evidence.

phase_6_report_presentation_object.title: Phase 6: Report Presentation Object
phase_6_report_presentation_object.summary: Define the generic presentation object with Evidence Map row identity, provenance, conformance conclusion, and draft finding fields.

phase_7_presentation_gates.title: Phase 7: Presentation Gates
phase_7_presentation_gates.summary: Prevent unsupported CONFORMS conclusions and unsupported draft finding candidates through applicability, evidence sufficiency, and search-coverage gates.

phase_8_fixture_expectation_migration.title: Phase 8: Fixture Expectation Migration
phase_8_fixture_expectation_migration.summary: Migrate fixtures to preserve accepted and rejected evidence and use the Evidence Map-backed draft presentation expectations.

phase_9_readiness_report_and_ui_consumer.title: Phase 9: Readiness Report and UI Consumers
phase_9_readiness_report_and_ui_consumer.summary: Implement downstream Pre-Validation Readiness Report and UI consumers using the finalized Evidence Map presentation contract.

phase_10_deprecation_review.title: Phase 10: Deprecation Review
phase_10_deprecation_review.summary: Review old labels and organization-specific profiles after the generic Evidence Map-backed product is proven.
